instruction: `click.version_option(version=None, *param_decls, ...)` takes the version string as its first positional argument, so `@click.version_option("--version", "-V")` silently uses "--version" as the version. Make `version` keyword-only: `version_option(*param_decls, version=None, package_name=None, prog_name=None, message=None, **kwargs)`, so every positional argument is an option name. Update every caller that passes the version positionally.
notes: Seeded 2026-10-05 on the current tip. Both positional callers are outside pytest: examples/repo/repo.py and tests/typing/typing_version_option.py (a type-check fixture, never collected). 2026-10-08: 31,000 parametrized stress-test ids (4 tests: test_stress_*) removed from pass_to_pass and deselected with pytest_args; they do not touch version_option.

Make `version` keyword-only: `version_option(*param_decls, version=None, package_name=None, prog_name=None, message=None, **kwargs)`, so every positional argument is an option name.
